mission: Make it dramatically easier for an ordinary human with a meaningful vision to accomplish extraordinary things with AI without becoming an AI project manager.
north_star: Maximum verified human value per unit of effort, with compounding intelligence and continuity.

truth_owners.evidence: Execution receipts, CI artifacts, runtime/render/whole-journey evidence

protected: MAXIS Living Sun presentation direction as recorded in Issue #69, without coupling presentation to scoring truth

execution_escalation.scope: Every consequential Naya/NayaPOWER/MAXIS execution, debugging cycle, investigation, verification cycle, and recovery attempt.
execution_escalation.rule: After three materially equivalent failures/blockers, stop blind repetition and perform a strategic reassessment. Attempt four must be materially different. More than ten materially equivalent attempts without strategy change is RED ALERT unless an explicit human-authorized exception is documented.
execution_escalation.required_record: ATTEMPT COUNT → OBSERVED RESULT → EVIDENCE → CURRENT HYPOTHESIS → ALTERNATIVE HYPOTHESIS → STRATEGY CHANGE → NEXT TEST

execution_map.current_program: Issue #66 — mechanically enforce the Naya Repository Operating Standard
execution_map.definition_of_done: Cold Naya can resolve identity, restore current state, identify the active block, and reject unsupported verification using machine-checkable artifacts.

design_direction.core_principle: The assessment is a living intelligence environment; the human choice visibly changes the environment while the question remains the visual priority.
design_direction.presentation_boundary: Presentation consumes MAXESS state; MAXESS engine remains authoritative for questions, answers, progression, scoring, and results.

resolution_rules: Resolve canonical identity before repository search.
Historical/superseded names are aliases, never current locators.
Current repository HEAD is authoritative over recorded HEAD claims.
UNKNOWN cannot satisfy VERIFIED or RACE_READY.
A block cannot be VERIFIED without appropriate evidence.
One highest-value next action must be exposed for the current block.
When materially equivalent execution fails three times, stop repeating the same approach and perform a strategic reassessment before another attempt.
After ten materially equivalent attempts without a material strategy change, treat the condition as RED ALERT and require a materially different route or documented human-authorized exception.
